{"consolidated_memory":"TRUNCATED DOCUMENTS IN search/indexer/chunker.ts: THREE DISTINCT INCIDENTS

Component: search/indexer/chunker.ts (search-side indexer)
Shared symptom across all occasions: chunk offsets that stop short of the document length, resulting in truncated documents
Shared reproduction: index the long changelog fixture

---

OCCASION 1: [2026-01-17]
Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
Root cause: clock skew between the two hosts
Fix: switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
PR #2152 on branch fix/truncated-documents-1
Result: the backlog cleared 41 minutes after the deploy
Note: same corner of search/indexer/chunker.ts as earlier work; context carried over

---

OCCASION 2: [2026-03-17]
Trigger: users sitting in a negative UTC offset
Root cause: the config loader reading the wrong environment file
Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
PR #2450 on branch fix/truncated-documents-2
Stack: TypeScript
Covering check: search/indexer/chunker.test.ts
Result: the nightly rollup matched the source counts for 36 days running

---

OCCASION 3: [2026-06-28]
Trigger: jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
Root cause: a mutable default argument shared across calls
Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call
PR #6469 on branch fix/truncated-documents-3
Result: the alert stayed quiet for 87 consecutive days
Note: same corner of search/indexer/chunker.ts as earlier work; context carried over

---

All three fixes have been deployed. Each occasion required different debugging and analysis in the same critical chunker code path."}
